subject: Joint onramp checklist + artifact handoff for NimbleCo evaluation
messages:
From: Jules Martin <jules@nimble.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimble.co>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eval artifacts & next steps for MAP

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our team is keen to run a short evaluation (2–4 weeks) against our search ranking prompts and some in-house testcases. Before we spin up the sandbox, procurement asked for a short mutual action plan and a list of artifacts you need from us.

High level ask from our side:
- A small prompt pack and testcase harness (ephemeral access) for a PoC.
- Clear restrictions on retention and redistribution.
- A suggested acceptance criteria and close timeline so our legal and procurement can sign off.

Can you send a MAP draft and a sample manifest of what you need to ingest? Happy to loop in our security contact if you need any certificates.

Best,
Jules Martin
Head of Search, NimbleCo
jules@nimble.co

Attachment: nimble-eval-manifest.csv (CSV)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jules Martin <jules@nimble.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts & next steps for MAP

Hi Jules —

Really appreciate the quick note. Attached is a one-page mutual onramp checklist (redwood-mpa-draft-v1.pdf) that lays out: artifact list, sandbox access rules, acceptance criteria, and a proposed 3-week close runway. Key bullets below:

- Artifacts we need from NimbleCo: prompt pack (.jsonl), scoring harness (zip), and a small labeled test subset (<= 2k examples). See attached manifest suggestions.
- Sandbox / usage constraints: ephemeral sandbox only; generated outputs and KV cache are NOT permitted to be exported. Ingested materials are retained for 90 days post-close and then purged unless explicitly vouched for in the SOW.
- Licensing: evaluation-only, non-distributable, internal use. No model fine-tuning with Nimble assets without a separate license.
- Acceptance criteria: precision@K targets (per your baseline), no regression larger than 3% on agreed prompt sets, and no blocker infra errors during 48-hour stability window.
- Suggested timeline: week 0 (ingest & sandbox setup), week 1–2 (evaluation run), week 3 (wrap + acceptance + takedown).

Next steps: if that looks good, Ben will send a short SOW + DocuSign attachment to procurement; Marissa will coordinate keys and temporary workspace. Karthik — tagging legal for the retention wording below.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min sync if you prefer to talk through the artifacts.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-mpa-draft-v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jules Martin <jules@nimble.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts & next steps for MAP

Thanks Hannah — quick legal/product clarifications on retention and scope so procurement has clear language:

1) Retention: "Ingested evaluation materials will be stored encrypted at rest and deleted from Redwood-managed storage 90 days after project close unless NimbleCo requests longer retention via signed amendment." Is NimbleCo comfortable with an explicit 90-day default?

2) Usage scope: confirm that "evaluation-only" precludes any redistribution or use for model training/fine-tuning. We should enumerate permitted internal uses (scoring, aggregation, short-term debugging) and prohibited uses.

3) Sandbox access & audit: we propose read-only workspace tokens for Nimble engineers plus scoped service accounts for Redwood engineers. Audit logs will be available on request for the evaluation window. Any objections?

If Nimble wants different retention (e.g., 180 days) we can include that in the SOW as an option with an associated storage fee.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product, Model Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Thanks — that draft looks good and the retention default of 90 days is acceptable for our pilot. Procurement asked me to confirm two things before I circulate:

2) Confirmation that Redwood will provide audit logs from the evaluation window on request (we may request a subset for a compliance checklist).

Ben — please send the SOW + DocuSign when ready. Procurement contact is procurement@nimble.co (cc'd). When the DocuSign is live I will route it internally and aim to return signed within 3 business days.
